names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 15 noiembrie, «Sfântul Mucenic Mărturisitor Aviv diaconul».

Read out of saint.gr's line for 15 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Γουρίας, Σαμωνάς και Άβιβος οι Ομολογητές», with the rank words left off. The line keeps the three together; the bare personal name is taken out of it.

Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 15 ноября ст. ст., «Мученик Авив Едесский», with the rank word left off. The line itself gives the name in the genitive and without the toponymic.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 15. новембар ст. ст., „Св. муч. Гурије, Самон и Авив.“ — «Св.» is “saint”, «муч.» is the `martyr` grade, and the other two names are the company; the deaconry is in the body and is the `deacon` grade `types` keeps, so the bare forename is the form. It joins a fold of three, declared in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` in the same commit.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 ноября ст. ст. — «Мучеников и исповедников Гурия , Самона (299-306) и Авива (322).»
doxologia.ro, calendarul pentru 15 noiembrie — «Sfântul Mucenic Mărturisitor Aviv diaconul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 15ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Γουρίας, Σαμωνάς και Άβιβος οι Ομολογητές»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 15 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. One line keeps the three confessors, and they are the three the corpus already holds from doxologia's 15 noiembrie. The page: Gurias and Samonas were taken by the governor Antoninus in the persecution under Diocletian and beheaded after many torments borne with wonderful patience; Abibus lived a few years later, came from a village of Edessa called Apothelsaia, was made hierodeacon in the reign of Licinius, the known rival of Constantine the Great, and was known for his piety and above all for his love of preaching — the page quotes 2 Timothy 4:2 over him — until the governor Lysanias, seeing him draw many idolaters by his preaching, hung him on a post, tore him with iron claws and then had him thrown into a fire outside the city. **No `dates` proposed**: the years on the page are reigns and governorships, Diocletian's and Licinius's, and no figure is given for any of the three. The Ἀπολυτίκιον names all three and the Κοντάκιον is their proper — it names Edessa and the maiden of their miracle — so both are copied onto all three folders; the Οἶκος and the Κάθισμα are not drafted. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 28.11.2025 (15. новембар ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Гурије, Самон и Авив.“

attestations.note: The third name in the day's first entry. `dates` UNTOUCHED: this book gives no year for him at all and puts its only year, 322, on the beheading of the other two, where this folder holds 322 for him and 299–306 for them off days.pravoslavie.ru. The two books therefore disagree about whose year 322 is, and nothing is moved on that account. No `related` row added; the three mutual rows are already on the folder. WHAT THE ENTRY ADDS: that he suffered after the other two and gave up his spirit in the flame, that his mother drew his body whole out of the fire and buried it with them in one grave, the church the Christians raised over the three and the single coffer, and the wonder of the Edessene girl buried alive in the Gothic land. The Serbian form „Авив“ widens a fold to three and the key is written in the same commit.

hymns.text: Ocrotitorii şi apărătorii Edesei, cei ce săvârşiţi minuni mari în lume, cei ce pe tânără aţi dat-o iarăşi în braţele maicii sale şi pe călcătorul de lege got l-aţi arătat osândit cu dreaptă judecată, cereţi pentru noi neîncetat să se mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — «Troparul Sfinților Mucenici Mărturisitori Gurie, Samona, Aviv diaconul», glas 4, the one troparion the three share

english.text: Protectors and defenders of Edessa, who work great wonders in the world, who gave the young woman back into her mother's arms and showed the law-breaking Goth condemned by a righteous judgement: ask unceasingly for us, that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Tριάδος ἰσάριθμοι τῆς Ὑπερθέου, σαφῶς Γουρίας καὶ Ἄβιβος καὶ Σαμωνᾶς ὁ κλεινός, ἔνθεοι ὑπάρχοντες ταύτην τοῖς ἀσεβέσιν ὡμολόγησαν ἅμα ἄθλων τὴν τρικυμίαν ἀβλαβῶς διελθόντες· καὶ νῦν ἡμᾶς κυβερνῶσιν ὅρμον πρὸς ἄκλυστον.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’. Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε — on the page of «Άγιοι Γουρίας, Σαμωνάς και Άβιβος οι Ομολογητές», and it names all three.

english.text: Equal in number to the Trinity that is above all godhead — Gurias plainly, and Abibus, and the renowned Samonas — being filled with God they confessed her together before the ungodly, and passed unhurt through the heavy sea of their contests; and now they steer us towards a harbour where no wave breaks.

hymns.text: Ἐξ ὕψους σοφοί, τὴν χάριν κομισάμενοι, τῶν ἐν πειρασμοῖς, προΐστασθε πανεύφημοι· διὸ κόρην Ἅγιοι, ἐκ θανάτου πικροῦ ἐῤῥύσασθε· ὑμεῖς γὰρ ὄντως ὑπάρχετε, Ἐδέσσης ἡ δόξα, καὶ τοῦ κόσμου χαρά.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’. Τὰ ἄνω ζητῶν — on the page of the three confessors. It names no one of them, but it is their proper and not a common: it names Edessa and the maiden their own miracle delivered.

english.text: Having carried grace down from on high, O wise ones, you stand before those in trials, all-praised; and so, O Saints, you delivered a maiden from a bitter death. For you are indeed the glory of Edessa and the joy of the world.

hymns.text: Чудеса святых Твоих мученик/ стену необориму нам даровавый, Христе Боже,/ тех молитвами советы языков разори,/ Церковь святую укрепи,// яко един Благ и Человеколюбец.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 ноября ст. ст. — «Тропарь мучеников и исповедников Гурия Самона и Авива», глас 5. It is the one troparion the three share, and it names none of them: a common of martyrs printed under their three names.

english.text: Christ God, who have given us the wonders of your holy martyrs for a wall that cannot be thrown down: by their prayers scatter the counsels of the nations and strengthen your holy Church, for you alone are good and the lover of mankind.

hymns.text: С высоты, мудрии, благодать приемше,/ сущим во искушениих предстоите, всехвальнии./ Темже отроковицу, святии, от смерти горькия избависте,// вы бо воистинну есте Едесу слава и миру радость.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 ноября ст. ст. — «Кондак мучеников и исповедников Гурия Самона и Авива», глас 2. It names no one of the three, but it is their proper and not a common: it names Edessa and the girl of their own miracle. It is the Slavonic of the kontakion saint.gr prints in Greek on the same three.

english.text: Having received grace from on high, O wise ones, you stand by those in trials, all-praised; and therefore, holy ones, you delivered the young girl from a bitter death. For you are truly the glory of Edessa and the joy of the world.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru, 15 ноября ст. ст.: «Мученик сам вошел в огонь и с молитвой предал дух свой Господу (+ 322)», and the calendar’s own line sets 322 against his name.
